notes: Maine athletes/relays only, read from the Hy-Tek results with the meet's own parser. A row was kept when its school resolves to a Maine school and the athlete appears for that school in our data the same school year, or when at least three of the school's athletes in this meet do (team evidence). Relays kept only for schools with matched individuals. Events outside the Maine indoor program (weight throw, 3000 m, 5000 m) not copied. Hamden CT and St. Dominic (NY/NJ) left out.
